topic: Total cost of piano lessons for a school term
core_question: Piano lessons cost $18 per week. Find the total cost for a 10-week term. (secondary: A coffee shop bill is $44. You leave a 25% tip. How much is the tip, in dollars?)
answer_summary: the total of $180 (10 weeks of piano lessons at $18 per week); after the topic shift: the tip of $11 (25% of a $44 bill)
persona: anxious and rambling; writing terse one-liners
